responsibility: Coordinates liveness generation for borrow checking by choosing which locals need analysis, computing which regions already outlive all free regions, optionally populating Polonius access facts, and invoking the main liveness tracer.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the liveness-analysis submodule under borrow-check MIR type checking, focused on selecting locals/regions that need liveness tracing and invoking that tracing. Other `mod.rs` files named here are broader module roots, while this one is a narrowly nested phase within type checking.
